scope: F1 circuit, pit lane, low smooth kerbs, markings, tidied astroturf and gravel; buildings and stands excluded

pitLane.layout: Longest connected medial path of the named pitlane mesh, smoothed, widened and joined to the main road. Core retained; entry and exit replaced with gradual tangent curves.

limitations: Supplied GLB surface reconstruction, not a surveyed or exact 2026 layout; the AC extension is missing its base Monza files.
The display tilt is removed, source hills and smoothed banking retained; banking capped at 6 degrees.
Kerb placement and colours come from the model; the width and low ramp profile are adapted for driving.
Runoff is a simplified, tidied projection onto the widened circuit; small grass slivers are filled.
Rectangular pieces have small overlaps and angular perimeter edges. Surface joins and live vehicle handling still need in-game validation.
Standing anchor maps horizontal pit position; elevated pit pavement can be above your feet. Lowest surfaces clear the grass by 0.25 studs.
